repos.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: CC Switch是基于Tauri 2的跨平台桌面应用，为Claude Code、Codex和Gemini CLI提供统一管理平台。该工具解决开发者在多AI编程助手间切换的痛点，集成API中继服务配置，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统。具备轻量级、高安全性特点，可显著提升AI辅助开发效率，实现一站式AI编码环境管理。
repos.summary_en: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2 that unifies management of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It eliminates workflow fragmentation by centralizing API relay configurations and model switching in a single interface. The lightweight, secure app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, streamlining AI-powered development and boosting developer productivity through consolidated tool management.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库逆向工程整理了30余款主流AI编程工具的系统提示词与内部机制，涵盖Cursor、Claude Code、Devin AI、Windsurf等核心产品。提供超过30,000行真实配置，为开发者、安全研究员和架构师提供罕见的AI代理架构底层洞察，适用于提示词工程优化、竞品分析和AI安全研究。
repos.summary_en: This repository reverse-engineers and aggregates system prompts and internal mechanisms from 30+ mainstream AI coding tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Devin AI, and Windsurf. With over 30,000 lines of actual configurations, it offers unprecedented insights into AI agent architectures for prompt engineering optimization, competitive analysis, and AI security research.

repos.description: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性生成式AI入门教程，包含21个实践课程，涵盖从基础理论到应用开发的全栈知识。面向初学者设计，提供多语言支持与开源社区协作，帮助开发者快速掌握生成式AI应用构建技能。内容权威且易于上手，适合自学、教学与企业培训场景。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official generative AI curriculum designed for beginners, offering 21 comprehensive lessons that take learners from foundational concepts to practical application development. This open-source project provides multi-language support through automated translations and encourages community contributions. Each lesson combines theoretical knowledge with hands-on coding exercises, covering essential topics like prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and AI application deployment. With low barriers to entry and enterprise-grade content, it serves as an ideal learning path for individual developers, educators, and organizations seeking to build generative AI capabilities quickly and effectively.

repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一个开源的 AI 代理编排平台，用于构建"零人力公司"。它通过 Node.js 服务端和 React 管理界面，协调多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）协同完成商业目标。核心功能包括组织架构管理、预算控制、目标对齐和任务追踪，让管理者像使用任务管理器一样 overseeing 整个 AI 团队。平台支持任意能接收心跳信号的代理，提供统一仪表盘监控工作进展和成本，实现 24/7 自动化运营，同时保留人工审计和干预能力。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for building "zero-human companies." It coordinates teams of AI agents through a Node.js backend and React dashboard, enabling autonomous business operations. The platform provides organizational charts, budget governance, goal alignment, and cost tracking across multiple agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Supporting any agent that can receive heartbeats, it functions as a task manager for AI teams, allowing 24/7 autonomous execution with human oversight. Users can define business goals, assign AI roles, and monitor progress from a unified interface, with pre-built company templates coming soon.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: An open-source RAG-based tool for chatting with your documents.
repos.summary_zh: kotaemon 是一款开源的 RAG（检索增强生成）文档对话工具，提供简洁易用的 Web UI。支持 OpenAI、Azure、Cohere 等云端 LLM API 及 Ollama、llama-cpp 本地模型，基于 Gradio 构建可高度定制的界面。既适合非技术用户快速搭建文档问答系统，也为开发者提供灵活的 RAG 管道框架，支持 Docker 部署和 Colab 一键运行。
repos.summary_en: Kotaemon is an open-source RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) document chat tool that provides a clean, minimalistic, and highly customizable Gradio UI. It supports diverse LLM backends—both cloud APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Cohere) and local models (Ollama, llama-cpp-python). Designed for dual audiences, it enables non-technical users to deploy document QA systems effortlessly via Docker or Colab, while offering developers a modular framework to build, extend, and fine-tune RAG pipelines with minimal coding effort.

repos.description: Humanizer 的汉化版本，Claude Code Skills，旨在消除文本中 AI 生成的痕迹。
repos.summary_zh: Humanizer-zh 是 Humanizer 的中文汉化版本，专为 Claude Code 打造的技能，用于识别并消除文本中的 AI 生成痕迹。该工具基于维基百科的 AI 写作特征指南，可检测 24 种 AI 写作模式，涵盖内容、语言、风格和表达四大类。通过自然语言重写，将机械的 AI 文本转化为流畅、真实的人类表达，适用于营销文案、学术摘要和博客文章等场景，显著提升中文内容的人性化程度。
repos.summary_en: Humanizer-zh is a Chinese localization of the Humanizer tool, designed as a Claude Code Skill to detect and eliminate AI-generated traces from text. Based on Wikipedia's AI writing patterns guide, it identifies 24 distinct AI writing patterns across content, language, style, and communication categories. The tool rewrites mechanical AI output into natural, human-like Chinese text, making it ideal for marketing copy, academic abstracts, and blog posts. It specifically addresses Chinese linguistic nuances while preserving core meaning and appropriate tone, significantly enhancing the authenticity of AI-generated content.

repos.description: 🆓免费的 ChatGPT 镜像网站列表，持续更新。List of free ChatGPT mirror sites, continuously updated.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库持续维护312个免费ChatGPT镜像站点列表，提供无需登录或低门槛访问GPT-4、Claude等AI模型的途径。收录网站涵盖完全免费、有免费额度等多种类型，并附带替代方案与自建指南，为开发者、研究人员及普通用户提供便捷的AI工具导航服务。
repos.summary_en: This repository maintains a continuously updated list of 312 free ChatGPT mirror sites, offering developers, researchers, and general users easy access to AI models like GPT-4, Claude, and DeepSeek without login or low barriers. It categorizes sites by free tiers, login requirements, and model support, while providing alternatives, self-hosting guides, prompt engineering resources, and developer tools for convenient AI tool discovery and implementation.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.summary_zh: Sure 是一款开源个人理财与财富管理应用，由社区维护的 Maybe Finance 分支发展而来。支持 Docker 自托管，提供浏览器、macOS 桌面、移动端、API 及 LLM 代理等多种客户端，内置 AI 助手解答财务问题，帮助用户全面掌控现金流、净资产与消费支出。
repos.summary_en: Sure is an open-source personal finance and wealth management app, a community-maintained fork of Maybe Finance. It supports Docker self-hosting and offers multiple clients including browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API, and LLM agents. An AI assistant answers financial questions, helping users track cashflow, net worth, and spending.

repos.description: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
repos.summary_zh: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
repos.summary_en: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

repos.description: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do
repos.summary_zh: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
repos.summary_en: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
repos.summary_zh: HA-MCP 是基于 Model Context Protocol 的智能家居 AI 网关，通过 FastMCP 提供 87 个工具，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手以自然语言配置和自动化控制 Home Assistant。支持 HACS 安装，兼容所有 Home Assistant 部署类型，实现全功能对等的进程内运行。
repos.summary_en: HA-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that bridges AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT with Home Assistant. Built with FastMCP, it exposes 87 tools for natural language configuration and automation of smart home devices. Installs via HACS or the built-in Marketplace, runs in-process, and supports all Home Assistant deployment types.

repos.description: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.
repos.summary_zh: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
repos.summary_en: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.description: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

repos.description: 📃 A better UX for chat, writing content, and coding with LLMs.
repos.summary_zh: Open Canvas 是 LangChain 开源的 AI 文档协作平台，基于 LangGraph 构建多智能体系统。核心亮点包括：内置反思智能体实现跨会话记忆，支持从现有文档开始而非强制聊天，提供可定制快捷操作和版本回溯，同时支持代码与 Markdown 实时渲染编辑。作为 OpenAI Canvas 的开源替代方案，它通过持久化用户风格规则实现个性化体验，适用于写作、编程等场景。
repos.summary_en: Open Canvas is LangChain's open-source AI document collaboration platform built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture. Key innovations include: built-in reflection agents with cross-session memory, starting from existing documents instead of chat-only, customizable quick actions, artifact versioning, and live code/Markdown editing. As an open alternative to OpenAI Canvas, it personalizes experiences by persisting user style rules and insights, ideal for writing, coding, and collaborative content creation.

repos.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
repos.summary_zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
repos.summary_en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
repos.summary_zh: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
repos.summary_en: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
repos.summary_zh: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
repos.summary_en: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

repos.description: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
repos.summary_en: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

repos.summary_zh: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

repos.description: Open-source AI humanizer: rewrite AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding prose. LLM rewriting + multi-engine translation, with step-by-step traces. Python CLI, n8n & Docker.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI文本人性化工具，采用DeepSeek大模型两次创造性重写结合Google与Niutrans多引擎翻译链，通过中文→日语→芬兰语→英语的远距离语言跳转，有效绕过Turnitin、GPTZero等主流AI检测器。5步标准管道保留原始写作风格，实现100%关键信息留存，专为学术写作与内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI text humanization toolkit that defeats Turnitin, GPTZero and all major AI detectors via a production-grade 5-step Standard Pipeline. Leverages DeepSeek LLM's creative rewriting at temperature 1.3 combined with multi-engine translation hops (Google Translate + Niutrans) across linguistically distant languages (Chinese→Japanese→Finnish→English). Preserves original writing style while achieving 100% key information retention, optimized for academic and content creation workflows.

repos.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
repos.summary_en: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.

repos.description: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
repos.summary_en: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: Perplexity style AI Search engine clone built with Gemini 2.0 Flash and Grounding
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Gemini 2.0 Flash 的 AI 搜索引擎，提供 Perplexity 式实时问答体验。核心亮点在于 Google Search Grounding 技术，确保答案附带可溯源的引用来源。全栈 TypeScript 架构（React + Express）实现高效开发，支持会话内追问，适用于研究、学习与精准信息检索场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini-Search is a production-ready AI search engine clone that replicates Perplexity's core functionality using Google's cutting-edge Gemini 2.0 Flash model. Its key technical innovation lies in the Search Grounding integration, which fetches real-time web results and automatically generates citations for every answer. The full-stack TypeScript implementation combines React with Vite on the frontend and Express.js on the backend, delivering a responsive, modern interface with conversational memory. Designed for researchers, students, and professionals seeking accurate, traceable information with minimal latency.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。
repos.summary_zh: 精选面向长期AI伴侣关系的开源软件、基础设施与社区，覆盖客户端、桌宠、主动心跳、长期记忆、情感状态、语音视觉具身与数据主权等模块，强调脱离官端自主运行，助力构建有记忆、主动性与持续性的人机恋体验。
repos.summary_en: Curated open-source list of software, infrastructure and communities for long-term AI companion relationships. Covers clients, desktop pets, proactive messaging, memory systems, emotion state, voice/visual embodiment and data ownership, enabling independent, memory-rich and proactive companions beyond official platforms.

repos.description: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统
repos.summary_zh: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
repos.summary_en: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.summary_zh: soundshuman是反AI写作痕迹（slop）工具集，整合多款开源humanizer精华：Markdown技能像人类编辑重写文本（41种模式+统计特征+声线校准，禁止捏造），JSON规则包供机器强制执行，零依赖Node CLI实现全文评分、分析、修复与仓库扫描，并支持CI门禁与pre-commit钩子。目标是可检查工作流——可见规则、可解释分数、可审查diff，而非对抗检测器。适用于文档、博客、代码仓库内容质量把控与AI智能体写作。
repos.summary_en: soundshuman is an anti-AI-slop toolkit that merges the best of existing humanizers: a Markdown skill that rewrites prose like a careful human editor (41 patterns, statistical tells, voice calibration, no fabrication), a machine-enforceable JSON rule pack, and a zero-dependency Node CLI for scoring, analyzing, fixing, and scanning entire repos with CI gates and pre-commit hooks. It prioritizes an inspectable workflow—visible rules, explainable scores, reviewable diffs—over beating detectors. Ideal for docs, blogs, and keeping AI agents’ output natural.

repos.description: Find your agents errors be fore your real users do
repos.summary_zh: ArkSim 是一款 AI 智能体仿真测试平台，通过 LLM 驱动的虚拟用户模拟真实多轮对话，在上线前自动检测智能体错误。提供 7 大内置评估指标，支持自定义度量，自动分类错误并分级。协议无关，支持 Chat Completions API 和 A2A 协议，生成可视化 HTML 报告，帮助开发者提前发现并修复问题。
repos.summary_en: ArkSim is an AI agent simulation testing platform that uses LLM-powered virtual users to simulate realistic multi-turn conversations, automatically detecting agent errors before deployment. It offers 7 built-in evaluation metrics, supports custom metrics, automatically categorizes and prioritizes failures. Protocol-agnostic, works with Chat Completions API and A2A, generating interactive HTML reports to help developers identify and fix issues proactively.
